name: Burning Hands
description:
Uncheck a condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within short range. On a win, it takes 2d6 damage. On a loss, it takes half damage.

If the unchecked condition was Anger, +1d damage.

Describe how your hands erupt in flame.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You may target one additional creature within short range.

💀: Check a condition.
